notes:
- Every attachment has its own job now (and its card says exactly what it does):
  - Optics: Red Dot aims in 25% faster; Holographic is the steadiest aim; the Sniper Scope is
    pinpoint aimed but wild from the hip.
  - Muzzle: the Suppressor no longer costs damage: quiet, small flash, less kick and **+25% headshot
    damage. Compensator**: much less recoil.
  - Barrel: Long (+damage, slower aim-in), Heavy (bullets go through one more zombie), new **Short
    Barrel** (aim in 30% faster, move faster while aiming, a little less damage).
  - Mag: Fast Mag (35% faster reloads), Extended, new Hollow Points (+25% body damage, weaker
    headshots).
  - Stock: Vertical Grip (35% less recoil), Padded Stock (steadier hip fire).
- New attachments that only fit certain guns:
  - Laser Sight (pistols and SMGs): a visible red laser and much tighter hip fire.
  - Auto Sear (P-12): fully automatic and faster.
  - Burst Kit (Vanguard AR): a hard-hitting 3-round burst.
  - Choke (shotguns): a much tighter pellet pattern.
  - Slug Rounds (shotguns): one heavy slug that flies true and punches through 3 more zombies.
  - Bayonet (rifles, shotguns, snipers): a blade under the barrel; quick melee hits 2.5x as hard.
  - Drum Mag (SMGs, rifles, LMGs): double the magazine, slower to reload and aim.
  - Speed Loader (Mag-50, Hand Cannon): reload in half the time.
  - Bipod (LMGs, snipers): crouch to brace it: 60% less recoil and half the spread.
- Shotguns don't take the Suppressor or Compensator any more (they get the Choke and Bayonet).
- The vertical grip on pistols now clamps right under the frame.
